recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 02: Pipeline, Pause Duration & Integration Verification. Validated TTSAudioPipeline lookahead pre-buffering heuristics, pause duration assignments (CLAUSE_BREAK 180ms, SENTENCE_BREAK 400ms, PARAGRAPH_BREAK 650ms, TITLE_BREAK 1000ms), and 11-paragraph sample story segmentation into 23 natural punctuation chunks. Updated OptimizedTextChunkingAndStateTest.kt assertions to expect DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 200. Verified via PunctuationFirstPipelineIntegrationTest.kt (3/3 passed).

Implemented Phase 01: Punctuation-First Segmenter Core Refactor. Configured DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 200 and SAFE_MAX_CHARS = 200. Refactored splitSentenceIntoSubClauses to extract sub-clauses at punctuation boundaries ([,;:—–-]) without mid-clause word-chopping, preserving compound words (e.g. 'sẵn sàng') and colon normalization ': -> :.'. Added emergency whitespace-boundary fallback for run-on clauses > 200 chars. Verified via PunctuationFirstSegmenterCoreTest.kt (4/4 passed).

Implemented Phase 04: BabbleGuard anti-hallucination engine with RMS energy envelope analyzer, speech burst detection, isBabbleSuspect heuristic, retry resynthesis loop up to 2 times, and babblePrefer candidate comparator. Verified via BabbleGuardAntiHallucinationTest.kt.

decisions_made.decision: Natural prosody clause accumulation up to 75 chars within 200 chars safe limit
decisions_made.reason: Allows short introductory clauses (like 'Ngày xưa,', 'Bất ngờ,') to naturally group with subsequent words while preventing runaway clauses over 200 chars and eliminating mechanical word-chopping on compound words like 'sẵn sàng'.
Prevents mechanical mid-clause word-chopping on Vietnamese compound words (such as 'sẵn sàng') while keeping pauses natural and aligned with punctuation marks.
Prevents acoustic voice drift and metallic tonal decay on long sentences caused by unbounded HashSet penalty.
Reduces sorting overhead from 1024 elements to 256 before softmax, achieving ~1.5x sampling speedup per frame.
Shields novel footnote brackets [1], [CV] from being stripped while preserving <|emotion_k|> special tokens.

decisions_made.decision: BabbleGuard Energy Envelope Burst Detection & Retry Loop
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates boundary static, clicks, and trailing babble in ultra-short utterances (<=2 syllables like 'Vâng.', 'Hả?').
